recipes.name: bridge
recipes.description: Apex-domain launcher with tiles, activity badges, and recent items across your stack.

recipes.name: docs
recipes.description: La Suite Docs — collaborative wiki and documentation platform with real-time editing. Maintained by France's DINUM.

recipes.name: drive
recipes.description: La Suite Drive — file storage, sharing, and organization with team workspaces. Maintained by France's DINUM.

recipes.name: keycloak
recipes.description: Identity and SSO provider. Required by every other service in the stack.

recipes.name: livekit
recipes.description: WebRTC SFU used by Meet for video and audio. Auto-included whenever Meet is enabled. Never shown in the wizard.

recipes.name: mattermost
recipes.description: Self-hosted team chat with channels, threads, and integrations. Logs in with your Keycloak account.

recipes.name: meet
recipes.description: La Suite Meet — open-source video conferencing built on LiveKit. Replaces Jitsi.

recipes.name: postgres
recipes.description: Single Postgres instance shared by all services that declare database.shared. Auto-included — never shown in the wizard.

recipes.name: redis
recipes.description: Single Redis instance shared by all services that declare redis.shared. Auto-included — never shown in the wizard.
